cohort: The study included 180 participants, divided into an early onset preeclampsia group (n=90) and a control group (n=90), with preeclamptic patients further subgrouped based on the presence of fetal growth restriction.
finding: Carbonic anhydrase IX levels were significantly higher in patients with preeclampsia and even higher in those with preeclampsia complicated by fetal growth restriction, demonstrating a predictive role for FGR in early onset preeclampsia.
